title: Academic Advice Surgery: Dealing with Mental and Emotional Health Concerns of Students – Part 2
content:
Supporting students is one of the most rewarding aspects of being an educator, but it can also bring emotional challenges. Building on our Part 1 discussion held both online in August and onsite this month at ACE2026, this second session will explore new questions and concerns raised by participants, exploring practical approaches to supporting mental and emotional wellbeing in the classroom and beyond.

Source
author: James Alexander Gordon
